Here are essential Hebrew phrases for greetings, everyday conversation, dining, and shopping.[[1]](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/100-basic-hebrew-phrases.html)[[2]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)

### Greetings & Courtesies

- **Hello / Goodbye / Peace:** Shalom (שלום)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **Good morning:** Boker tov (בוקר טוב)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **Good evening:** Erev tov (ערב טוב)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **How are you?** 
	- To a male: Ma shlomcha? (מה שלומך?)
	- To a female: Ma shlomech? (מה שלומך?)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **What’s up? / How are things:** Ma nishma? (מה נשמע?) or Ma koreh? (מה קורה?)[[1]](https://www.touristisrael.com/hebrew-language-guide-for-tourists-in-israel/24759/)[[2]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **Thank you:** Toda (תודה)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **Thank you very much:** Toda raba (תודה רבה)[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wOMEoQ0DR84)
- **Please / You’re welcome:** Bevakasha (בבקשה)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **Excuse me / I’m sorry:** Slicha (סליחה)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **Yes / No:** Ken (כן) / Lo (לא)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **No problem:** Ein be'ayah (אין בעיה)[[1]](https://www.hebrewpod101.com/lesson/absolute-beginner-hebrew-for-every-day-1-top-25-hebrew-phrases)

### Dining & Shopping

- **How much is this?** Kama zeh oleh? (כמה זה עולה?)[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wOMEoQ0DR84)[[2]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **I want…** 
	- Male: Ani rotzeh... (אני רוצה...)
	- Female: Ani rotzah... (אני רוצה...)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **Do you have…?** 
	- To a male: Yesh lecha…? (יש לך...?)
	- To a female: Yesh lach…? (יש לך...?)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **Water / Coffee:** Mayim (מים) / Kafeh (קפה)[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)
- **The check, please:** Cheshbon, bevakasha (חשבון, בבקשה)[[1]](https://dental-dvi.org.il/common-professional-hebrew-phrases/)
- **Where is the bathroom?** Eifo ha'sherutim? (איפה השירותים?)[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wOMEoQ0DR84)

### Popular Slang & Expressions

- **Cool / Awesome:** Sababa (סבבה) or Achla (אחלה)
- **Let’s go / Come on:** Yalla (יאללה)
- **Long live the people of Israel:** Am Yisrael Chai (עם ישראל חי)[[1]](https://reformjudaism.org/blog/eight-hebrew-words-and-phrases-learn)[[2]](https://dental-dvi.org.il/common-professional-hebrew-phrases/)[[3]](https://www.touristisrael.com/hebrew-language-guide-for-tourists-in-israel/24759/)

You can explore a complete list of vocabulary and audio guides through [Teach Me Hebrew](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/100-basic-hebrew-phrases.html) or practice everyday conversation topics via [HebrewPod101](https://www.hebrewpod101.com/blog/2022/01/28/hebrew-beginner-phrases/).[[1]](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/100-basic-hebrew-phrases.html)[[2]](https://www.hebrewpod101.com/blog/2022/01/28/hebrew-beginner-phrases/)Would you like to focus on **travel phrases**, **dining out** , or **Hebrew slang** for your next step?
